_comment: Word and question pools for the two non-video modes.
Each round picks ONE PAIR: the crewmates get `normal`, the suspect(s) get
`imposter`. Unlike videos.json, the two halves are AUTHORED TOGETHER and
must not be drawn independently — that is the whole design of this file.
Two random words are almost never a game: BEACH against PHOTOSYNTHESIS is
over on the first clue. A pair only works when the honest answers overlap,
so the suspect can say something true about their own card and have it
pass. Aim for near misses that share the obvious associations and differ
on one axis: WEDDING/FUNERAL both give you church, family, flowers, suit.
`note` is an internal comment and is never sent to players.
Keep each pool at 12+ pairs so repeats stay rare within a lobby session.

words.note: cold, swims, black and white, fish
